digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow - optionality lane
propositions: The degradation-path tests step in _optionality.yml runs without predates-gate guards on two test files that may not exist in older patchsets, causing pytest exit code 4 and false Verified -1 failures
The workflow already applies the two-generator guard pattern to a similar test file (test_cli_registry_distribution.py) but failed to apply it to test_llm_optionality.py and test_completion_gate.py
Each test file must be guarded independently so that a tree with one file but not the other still runs the file that exists

The fix applies per-file presence guards following the pattern from bugs 1909 and 5bc6, building the pytest node-id list dynamically from present files while preserving the canonical message when both are absent
